description.text: Tuition Standard (1) Chinese Government Scholarship students are free of charge. (2) The tuition for self-supporting students is CNY 14,800 to 16,400 per school year. Note: the tuition must be paid fully during registration at the beginning of each semester. Deadline of Application June 30 every year Commencment of teaching The first Monday of September

duration.text: The Garments Design and Technology at Jiangnan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2055 USD/per year ￥ 14800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.
